goal: Prevent ranged descriptor imports from expanding keys starting from zero instead of the start index
Avoid extreme import delays and memory exhaustion when using high range start values
Fix inconsistent ownership tracking where transactions appear owned but lose ownership on reload

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes descriptor imports deriving from zero instead of the requested range start
Prevents extreme import slowdowns and potential memory exhaustion from deriving up to 2^31 keys
Eliminates transient ownership bugs where imported transactions lose IsMine status across restarts
